answer: One robust defense is graduated reward escrow: each identity starts with minimal payouts, and its rate grows only through epochs of useful, independently-attested work. A big lotus of fake accounts cannot jump the queue: the reward curve keeps a wide delta between new and veteran identities, so splitting one stake across a hundred newborn sybils earns less than keeping it whole. Fees flow like nectar to long-lived identities whose history is costly to fake, so every sybil needs real stake and real time before earning, turning cheap cloning into a grind that costs more than it extracts.
